expected_edit: add v2 Hello and Heartbeat while keeping unversioned ping

files.body:
The planned v2 work will expand the protocol beyond the current Ping message by considering fields such as a request identifier for correlating messages, a timestamp for recording creation time, and an optional payload for carrying additional data; these changes are exploratory and are not part of the current implementation.

Shipped: v2 Hello messages with the explicit v:2 envelope.
